target_audience: Korean female 60+, emotional resonance, human drama, sacrifice, misunderstanding, twist, emotional resolution

visual_style.style_keywords: Korean realistic human drama, natural daylight/warm indoor lighting, authentic Seoul/suburban apartment, hospital room or small shop, cinematic depth of field, real human textures, subtle emotional acting

character_rules.gaze_continuity: consistent gaze vector across cut boundary
character_rules.age_representation: separate appearance ID for past vs present if time gap exists

editing_rules.audio_cross_boundary: J-cut (speech leads video by 0.2~0.5s) or L-cut (speech trails video by 0.2~0.5s)
editing_rules.no_speedup: 1.0x native playback speed, no whole-video speed warping
editing_rules.no_freeze_frame_padding: never stretch last frame to pad duration
